counterfactual_missing_items: No cholesteatoma-specific findings such as attic retraction pocket or keratin debris are described.
No unifocal middle ear/mastoid soft-tissue mass is described.
The separate left parietal osteolytic lesion is not explained by cholesteatoma.
decisive_items: bilateral osteolysis of the mastoids, superior and lateral semicircular canals, and the right external auditory canal
separate osteolytic lesion in the dorsal left parietal bone
right external canal was occluded by polypoid tissue and purulent secretion
response.rationale: R2 is favored because the imaging shows multifocal lytic bone lesions (bilateral temporal bone and separate parietal lesion) characteristic of Langerhans cell histiocytosis, whereas R1 explains the ear canal polyp and mastoid erosion but cannot account for the distant parietal osteolytic lesion or bilateral semicircular canal involvement.
